//: Powers that leave something in the world bound to them (08 §7.3): a summoned hound and a conjured wall. Each ends with its binding: the hound is gone, the street comes back. Nobody has them by default; the template and the trait `power_sampler` give them. Values are illustrative.
doc: Staying at the heel of whoever the character serves: the owner of the ability it is bound to, kept within two metres of where it believes them to be. Wanted only by a character bound to someone.
A summoned hound. Takes its summoner's quarrels as its own: goes for anyone it holds hostile while it can see them. Otherwise keeps at its summoner's heel.

//: Calls a dog to a cell close by, bound to the ability for a while: it thinks as a `hound` and takes its summoner's stances (09 §3.4). When the time runs out, or the summoner dies, or the ability is lost, it is gone.
name: Summon hound
Summon hound
description: A hound comes to your call and serves you for a while.

//: Raises a wall across the way toward a cell: a line of wall blocks through it, square to the user's way, put there through `WorldEdit` and bound to the ability. When the binding ends each cell that is still the wall is put back as it was; one knocked down or changed since is left alone.
name: Stone wall
fail_text: Raise it somewhere in front of you.

name: Stone wall
description: A wall rises across the way and sinks back when the power ends.
